headline: FFO growth accelerates, guidance raised as profit cools

kpis.label: Core FFO per share (ex. net promote)

summary_short: Digital Realty's Q2 revenue rose 29% y/y to $1.9B and FFO per share jumped 56% to $2.73, while GAAP diluted EPS of $1.21 fell sharply from $2.94 a year earlier; management raised full-year Core FFO per share guidance to $8.15-$8.20.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 29% y/y (18% q/q) to $1.9B, driving FFO per share to $2.73 (+56% y/y) and AFFO to $2.47 (+47% y/y). Core FFO per share (ex. net promote) reached $2.13 (+14% y/y) on 25.4% cash rent growth on renewals, 90.2% occupancy and 8.9% same-capital cash NOI growth. GAAP net income fell 56% y/y to $458M and diluted EPS to $1.21 from $2.94 in 2Q25 — a comparison the release does not explain. The quarter included $188M of net promote income and a $94M insurance settlement. Digital Realty raised FY2026 Core FFO per share guidance to $8.15-$8.20 and revenue guidance to $6.85-$6.95B; direct capex was $832M.
